rt2x00: remove leading spaces before tabs

There are a few leading spaces before tabs and remove it by running the
following commard:

	$ find . -name '*.c' | xargs sed -r -i 's/^[ ]+\t/\t/'
	$ find . -name '*.h' | xargs sed -r -i 's/^[ ]+\t/\t/'
